  "description": "Formally known as Guber Express Courier Services, Now GUO Logistics (GUOL)&mdash;a subsidiary of our parent company, GUO Transport Co.&mdash;is a logistics company with a strong heritage. With over ten years&rsquo; experience in the industry, we have transformed the way logistics is accessed by our clients across Nigeria and beyond. Seamlessly adapting technology into our operations, we pride ourselves in being at the forefront delivering innovative value to customers. We operate a large fleet of trucks and maintain a network of strategically located offices across the country, helping you get your goods at the right destination in record time. Today, GUOL has its Headquarters in Onitsha, Anambra State with its Corporate office in Lagos State. The company is known for its commitment to customer satisfaction and timely delivery, making it a trusted choice for individuals and businesses seeking reliable logistics solutions in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Representative
Job Location: 33 Nkwelle Ezunaka, Anambra
Employment Type:

Responsibilities


	Serve as the first point of contact for customers, providing professional assistance on parcel booking, rates, delivery timelines, and other logistics inquiries.
	Coordinate therouting and tripping of parcelsto ensure prompt dispatch and timely delivery across all GUO Logistics locations.
	Supervise and verify proper packaging, registration, and inspectionof parcels before dispatch to ensure compliance with company policies and safety standards.
	Track and monitor parcels in transit and proactively update customers on delivery status or any service delays.
	Maintain accurate shipment documentation including waybills, manifests, receipts, and proof of delivery.
	Handle customer complaints, claims, and inquiries effectively, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
	Work closely with the operations and dispatch teams to facilitate smooth coordination between terminals and delivery points.
	Record and maintain customer data and transaction history accurately in the CRM system.
	Support revenue collection and ensure all transactions are properly recorded and accounted for.
	Promote GUO Logistics services by maintaining a positive and professional image in all customer interactions.

Formally known as Guber Express Courier Services, Now GUO Logistics (GUOL)—a subsidiary of our parent company, GUO Transport Co.—is a logistics company with a strong heritage. Internal Control Officer Job at Casalavoro Limited




        
    

        
        Casalavoro Limited is a fast-growing company with diverse interests in Real Estate, Hospitality, Asset Management, and Agricultural Commodity Trading. We're committed to excellence and innovation, delivering top-tier services that set new industry standards. Our expertise and passion drive growth, reliability, and exceptional client experiences.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Internal Control Officer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 

Job Summary

	CasaLavoro Real Estate is seeking a detail-oriented and highly ethical Internal Control Officer to strengthen our internal control, risk management, compliance, and financial monitoring processes.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor internal controls, policies, and SOP compliance.
	Review property sales, payments, refunds, expenses, and vendor transactions.
	Conduct periodic and surprise audits/checks across departments and project sites.
	Identify control gaps, fraud risks, and irregularities and recommend corrective actions.
	Ensure proper documentation and regulatory compliance.
	Prepare internal control reports and track closure of audit findings.
	Work closely with Finance, Sales, Legal, and Project teams.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
	3–5 years of experience in internal control, internal audit, risk, or compliance.
	Real estate/construction experience is an advantage.
	Strong Excel and analytical skills.
	Knowledge of accounting/ERP or CRM systems.
	Professional certification such as ICAN, ACCA, CIA, or CISA is an added advantage.
	High integrity, confidentiality, attention to detail, and strong communication skills.


Remuneration
Competitive and negotiable, based on experience.
